annotation.title_clean: 14 CFR Part 91—General Operating and Flight Rules
annotation.title_en: 14 CFR Part 91—General Operating and Flight Rules
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Federal Aviation Administration (US Department of Transportation)
annotation.summary_en: US Federal Aviation Regulations Part 91, the general operating and flight rules for civil aircraft in the United States. It covers pilot-in-command authority, airspace classes, right-of-way, altitudes, equipment, recorders and special flight rules. It is conventional crewed-aviation regulation. Part 107 small unmanned aircraft are only mentioned as excluded.
key_provisions_or_claims: Pilot in command is directly responsible for and final authority over aircraft operation (§91.3)
Prohibits careless or reckless operation and sets minimum safe altitudes and speed limits
Class A-D airspace requirements for clearances, communications and equipment
Special Federal Aviation Regulations, including Grand Canyon flight-free zones and Alaska GPS RNAV operations
Part 91 does not apply to aircraft governed by Part 107 (small UAS), except specified sections
